text_block_list.text:
That day, the members were summoned. 
Currently, several dozen Umamusume are 
participating in Project L'Arc.

However, only four can challenge the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe— To truly win, one 
must be prepared to select the Umamusume 
capable of victory.

Aiming to grow stronger and reach greater 
heights, <chrname> partners with Tap Dance City to 
target the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

They promised each other that they would 
compete with everything they had for the 
romantic dream of the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe.
